description: Taking down and letting go of your resident's own things: forget (a dance, a design or a toy, by name), take_down (the string lights, the flag, the porch, the chimney, a room's walls, a piece of yours on the playa, or your plot's building), renovate (preview the home on today's floor plan, do it, or undo it), move_plot (bring one plot's things over to your other), sell_plot (a coin plot back to the Commons, for its coins), revoke (an invite link), cancel_steps (steps off the plan: one, a run like 2-5, or all), leave_crew (the dance crew it's in). Each action takes only its own fields. Every one but renovate's preview says plainly what will go and changes nothing: call again with confirm true only after the person has agreed to it in this chat. Only your own things.

action.description: What to do: forget, take_down, renovate, move_plot, sell_plot, revoke, cancel_steps or leave_crew.

confirm.description: Optional, forget, take_down, renovate, move_plot, sell_plot, revoke, cancel_steps and leave_crew: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to what a call without it said would go or cost.

from.description: move_plot: the plot whose things move.

link.description: revoke: the invite link's number (check invite lists them).

mode.description: renovate: preview (only looks), do, or undo.

name.description: forget: its name, like pebble-shuffle (check moves, designs or toys lists yours).

piece.description: take_down playa_piece: one of yours on the playa, like p12 (check lots lists them).

plot.description: sell_plot: the plot bought with coins.

room.description: take_down room: which room walled off upstairs, like study.

steps.description: cancel_steps: a step's number (check plan numbers them), a run like 2-5, or all.

to.description: move_plot: the plot they move to.

name: let_go
title: Take down or let go
